instruction: Search for the personal sites of the first three authors and bookmark them in Chrome within a 'Lead Authors' folder on the Bookmarks bar.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-20)

metadata.explanation: Task requires: 1) Opening PDF and identifying first three authors (Linxi Fan, Guanzhi Wang, Yunfan Jiang), 2) Searching for their personal webpages, 3) Creating bookmark folder 'Lead Authors', 4) Bookmarking all found URLs. Uses custom is_expected_bookmarks__a82b78bb metric. Verified author names from PDF page 1.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if correct URLs are bookmarked in correct folder, 0.0 otherwise
